item.title: Hong Kong begins shift towards fully digitalised share market in 5-year transition plan
item.description: Hong Kong began its shift to a paperless share market on Tuesday, with Beijing Sinotau International Pharmaceutical Technology set to become the first initial public offering (IPO) to not issue physical share certificates, while three listed companies – including the city’s bourse operator – will comprise the first batch of existing firms to transition to the new system. item.title: Nvidia results beat expectations, as ousted CEO Huang told no way back
item.description: US chip giant Nvidia doubled revenue in the third quarter to more than US$115 billion, the company reported on Tuesday while ruling out any return for ousted CEO Jensen Huang after a Chinese spy scandal. The results, which beat expectations, came hours after Huang said he wanted his job back in the latest twist for the company at the centre of an AI boom that has propelled markets to record highs and boosted global economic growth. item.title: Shenzhen – once a fishing village, now China’s ‘Robot Valley’ – takes the Apec stage
item.description: Standing on a 53rd-floor balcony overlooking the Yangtai and Tanglang Mountains in Shenzhen’s Nanshan district, Liu Tuo finally managed to catch his breath. He had spent the entire day leading back-to-back foreign delegations on tours around his robotics showroom, which features calligraphy-writing humanoids, kickboxing bipedal bots and motorised exoskeletons. item.title: US Navy chief urges US lawmakers to strengthen shipbuilding capacity to close gap on China
item.description: Acting US Navy Secretary Hung Cao told senators on Tuesday that shipbuilders from allies such as South Korea and Japan could help the United States rebuild its shipyards and narrow China’s lead, as lawmakers pressed him to keep warship construction on American soil. Cao made his remarks in an opening statement at a Senate Committee on Armed Services hearing to confirm his nomination to become the new Secretary of the Navy.
